svg.text: Board configuration cmod_a7_35_no_pll_tiny_vga_304_no_tm1638_claude. The Cmod A7 sits in a breadboard across its center channel; the modules connect with jumper wires.

svg.text: INMP441 L/R is driven low by the FPGA; you may connect it to GND instead and leave DIP 31 free.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Unplug USB before changing the wiring. VU, DIP 24, stays unconnected: there is no 5 V on the breadboard, and the DIP pins take 3.3 V at most.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: DIP 1 to 14, 17 to 20 and 33 to 48 are the GPIO pins of the labs, gpio[0] to gpio[33]; GPn is gpio[n]. Nothing is connected to them here.
